args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
========================

Based on your Hawaii trip itinerary (June 10th - June 20th, 2024)

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (multiple sets for beach days and snorkeling)
- Sunscreen (high SPF, reef-safe recommended)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike)
- Casual outfits (for daily activities and luau)
- Camera (to capture memories at beaches, Pearl Harbor, etc.)
- Travel documents (passport/ID, hotel confirmations, flight info)

Additional Recommended Items:
- Beach towel
- Water shoes (for snorkeling at Hanauma Bay)
- Light rain jacket (for possible showers)
- Hat and sunglasses
- Reusable water bottle
- Snorkel gear (optional, can be rented)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Evening attire (for dinner outings)
- Small backpack/day bag
- Power bank for phone charging
- Medications and first aid supplies
- Insect repellent

Don't forget to check weather forecasts before finalizing your packing!
